findings.title: G7 has no independently audited dependency edges, so L/U mechanism selection is not eligible
findings.evidence: The final G7 V/L/U audit covers 92 public cases and reports edge_count_distribution={0:92} with eligible_u_cases=0. The G7-to-G8 handoff has mechanisms=[] and selection=REQUIRES_EXTERNAL_TRACE_AND_SCIENTIFIC_REVIEW.
findings.remediation: Obtain an independent scientific/trace review and, if L or U is proposed, an independently audited replacement edge/state-transition dataset with source hashes. Do not auto-select L or invent edges.

findings.title: G7 provider failures and low independent Q coverage block a clean G8 mechanism handoff
findings.evidence: The canonical G7 run retains all 1288 fork IDs and 184 checkpoint IDs, but only 993/1288 forks and 153/184 checkpoints completed. Independent Q audit has 3 valid and 1285 invalid rows.
findings.remediation: Keep terminal failures and Q invalidity unchanged. Before confirmatory G8 use, diagnose provider failures and obtain independent trace/Q review or run a separately frozen retry plan.

findings.title: No frozen, auditable G8 real/sham/off/extra adapter is present
findings.evidence: Repository inspection found G6/G7 runners but no G8 implementation exposing M_real, M_sham, M_off and generic_extra_thinking with the required mechanism events and hard per-call budgets. The G8 example config still contains placeholder model snapshot text.
findings.remediation: After G7 selection=GO, implement and independently review the real adapter, freeze its operation contract/version hash, public checkpoint mapping, model snapshot, hard limits, sham construction and G4 removal semantics before any paid run.

positive_checks: G8 SKILL.md and references 01-06 were read completely from the supplied ZIP.
G8 package tests passed 8/8 after isolating and repairing a Windows shlex adapter-path parsing defect in the temporary review copy; the supplied ZIP itself was not modified.
A real-input audit attempt was correctly rejected by the G8 selection gate with G7 handoff not GO; no demo result was promoted to science.
G7 final input audit reports 92 cases, 23 families, 552 handoff rows and has_demo_or_mock=false.
G7 score reports 1288 planned/provided states, 993 completed states, 295 terminal failures and 1288 independent Q rows with only 3 valid.
No G8 paid provider call, six-arm plan, raw run, score or causal claim was created after the gate failure.

scientific_caveats: G7 diagnostic D/V/L/U interventions are information interventions, not proof of an executable endogenous mechanism.
G8 cannot choose L merely because L appears in G7 diagnostic labels; selection must be externally reviewed and frozen.
A blocked G8 gate is not a zero-effect result and must not be reported as a causal null.
The six-arm G8 design remains unexecuted; no GO, REVISE or STOP causal conclusion is available beyond the pre-run BLOCKED status.
